decision: Phuong an HEP cho vong nay: server kiem tien de cua co replaceUnreadableStore + client phan loai loi doc duong ca hai chieu. Hop nhat ve server (PUT thoi ghi de toan phan) -> ho so ke, Known limit co ten.
impact: Loai phuong an sau: doi hop dong day, cham moi bieu mau, ho so to. Nhan downside: PUT {env:{}} KHONG co van xoa kho lanh — khong call-site nao gui hom nay, nhung do la su that ve call-site, khong ve hop dong day. Owner chon 03/09.

decision: Ca ba manh cua Ngoai-2 vao hop dong: phan loai 401 rieng + ban tf:unauthorized + tran 30s cho ca doc lan ghi.
impact: Loai phuong an bo seam (vo khong tu dung hop dang nhap) va phuong an chi phan loai (man quay vong vinh vien). Nhan downside: phep do seam chi khang dinh su kien duoc BAN, nguoi nghe o src/ext/ bi gitignore — Known limit co ten.

decision: Seam tf:unauthorized rut thanh helper notifyUnauthorized() trong src/lib/api/client.ts, hai ben goi — KHONG chep inline sang env-client.
impact: Loai phuong an chep: ban sao thu hai cua seam tai tao dung 'ba noi tu viet' ma ca dong ho so nay chong. Doi lai: diff cham them client.ts (khong doi hang) + mot guard cau truc (AC-8).

decision: 403 -> unavailable, KHONG phai unauthenticated; seam chi ban voi 401.
impact: Can cu RFC 9110 (401 chua xac thuc, 403 da xac thuc nhung bi cam) va dieu kien that cua apiClient client.ts:171 (chi 401). Loai phuong an gop 401/403 o ban nhap dau. Later: 403 co copy rieng.

decision: Ngoai-3/7 (ghi khoa that bai hien tick xanh 'Da luu khoa') KHONG vao vong nay -> ho so rieng.
impact: Van HIGH, van mo. Owner tach 03/09 de giu vong nay quanh mot bat bien (luot DOC). Doi lai: rui ro noi sai o luot GHI con trong san pham cho toi ho so ke.

decision: bỏ đường-đo — hồ sơ không có opportunity.md; đi từ Cổng 2 của chong-mat-khoa-byo-giao-dien, không từ Cổng Đáng
impact: Cổng Giá trị sẽ đọc bảng ngưỡng với ô CHƯA ĐO — quyết release/iterate/kill mất căn cứ số. Không có ngưỡng nào được khai nên không có ô nào để đo.

decision: Chay design-pass (S1-D) tren ban mau rieng khong-noi-sai-ve-kho-khoa-proto; mo buoc phan ky: A mot sac vs B hai giong, may khuyen B, ghim tren canh divergence.
impact: Loai duong bo design-pass (Gate 1 duyet UI bang chu). Nhan downside: material=scaffold cho hai state moi vi component chua co prop tone — Nhom 2 cho Gate 1 quyet. Neu owner chon A thi prop tone khong can, E5/E13 giu nguyen; chon B thi S3 them prop + do lai tuong phan dark.

decision: Sua chu AC-4 va E4 cho khop ma that: put() TRA VE {ok:false, reason:'write-failed', detail:{code:'timeout'}} — them mot nhanh vao union WriteFailure, KHONG them duong nem. Owner chon duong A (sua chu, ghi vet, khong duyet lai Cong 1) ngay 03/09.
impact: Ban duyet o Cong 1 viet 'put() NEM Error, giu duong throw de nhanh writeFailed hien co bat'. Doc ma o S2 cho thay KHONG co duong throw nao de giu: env-client tra ve SaveOutcome, ba caller doc out.ok roi re nhanh. Them throw se roi vao catch cua abi-node-shell:253 -> phase 'invalid' -> 'khoa cua ban hong, go lai di', dung bay ma ho so truoc vua go (chu thich tai dong 152-156 noi vay). Y DINH cua AC khong doi — khong treo, khong bao thanh cong gia; chi ten co che doi. Goc loi: gap-probe chi doc artifact, khong doc code, nen no suy 'giu duong throw' tu chu writeFailed trong hop dong va toi chep lai ma khong kiem. Doi lai: mot AC da dong dau bi sua sau seal — trinh o Cong 2 trong khoi provisional.

decision: Task 2 (rut helper seam) tach RIENG khoi Task 3 (taxonomy), du ca hai cung phuc vu AC-3.
impact: Loai phuong an gop: mot task doi ca client.ts lan env-client.ts thi luc chieu-do khong phan biet duoc 'helper chua rut' voi 'nhanh 401 chua goi'. Doi lai: guard cua Task 2 DO CO CHU Y cho toi khi Task 3 them caller thu hai — mot trang thai trung gian phai khai truoc, khong thi nguoi doc tuong hoi quy.

decision: Ba task doc lap (1 server, 2 seam, 5 tone+i18n) chay song song; nam task con lai tuan tu.
impact: Ba task do khong dung file nao chung va khong task nao doc Produces cua task kia. Doi lai: phai merge ba nhanh worktree truoc khi vao Task 3, va neu Task 5 doi ten prop thi Task 6 phai doc lai.

decision: E4 them mot ca DUNG BE MAT that (mount abi-node-shell voi fetch treo), khong chi do promise cua env-client.
impact: Gap-probe F1: AC-4 hua mot ket cuc o BE MAT ('node khong ket o dang-kiem'), ma ba ca kia chi do lop lib. Doi lai: mot ca test nang hon (render component trong fake timers), va no la ca duy nhat bat duoc neu ai do doi return thanh throw.

decision: Cong 1.5 (duyet ke hoach, T3): owner dat /goal ngay sau khi may trinh ke hoach kem khuyen nghi duyet; dieu kien hoan thanh cua goal doi di qua S3 va S4. May doc do la lenh di tiep.
impact: Owner KHONG go chu 'duyet' tuong minh. Ghi vet o day thay vi im lang, de Cong 2 thay mot cong da di qua bang suy dien chu khong bang phat ngon. Ke hoach da commit (ee25515) nen owner van doc va chan duoc bat cu luc nao.

decision: S3 chay TUAN TU trong main loop, KHONG dung execute-parallel du ke hoach co 3 task independent.
impact: Loai phuong an song song: no dung worktree rieng, moi worktree can node_modules, va may nay co bay da do (STATUS.md: agent lam hong node_modules cay goc, go phai rm -rf). Ba task la it, loi song song nho hon rui ro. Doi lai: cham hon vai phut.

decision: Bang anh xa trang-thai->the nam trong MOT component chung (read-state-notice.tsx), khong phai moi be mat mot ban nhu ke hoach viet.
impact: Loai phuong an ba ban sao: chinh co che sinh ra loi nay la ba be mat tu quyet dinh lay. Doi lai: mot lop truu tuong moi, va chu cua the doc tu i18n namespace thay vi di qua prop bag. Loi kem: nut Thu lai nam trong component nen 9 o khong-ok deu co loi ra do CAU TAO.

decision: Sua hai bo do cua ho so truoc (store-unreadable-refusal, settings-dialog.unreadable) thay vi giu chung xanh: chung khang dinh chinh hanh vi dang duoc sua.
impact: Rui ro: sua test cho xanh de truot thanh che loi. Phan biet bang cau hoi test cu khang dinh dieu DUNG hay khang dinh HIEN TRANG — o day la hien trang da xac dinh sai. Bat bien that cua chung giu nguyen va manh hon: loi ra phai la control song, nay Thu lai cung duoc kiem cung cach.

decision: Chua lo hong onRetry bang CAU TRUC (export NodeKeyGateSurface — mot cho dung duy nhat, gate so huu retry), khong bang cach truyen them mot prop o cho dung.
impact: Loai phuong an sua-mot-dong: bo do van se dung be mat thay the va van mu. Doi lai: mot component export them, va bo do phai doi sang mount vat that. Loi: go onRetry o cho dung that gio lam do 3 o ma truoc do khong o nao do.

decision: Doc than phan hoi BEN TRONG tran thoi gian (fetchWithCeiling tra {response, body, parsed}) thay vi de callers tu goi response.json() sau khi dong ho da tat.
impact: Doi lai: helper tra shape rong hon va hai caller phai doi. Duoc: cai treo ma tran sinh ra de chan (proxy tra header roi dung than) that su bi chan — moi ca timeout cu deu dung header nen khong ca nao thay lo do. Abort GIUA lut doc than phai bao timeout, khong bao not-json.

decision: Bo do i18n dung vat ship (ReadStateNotice) va chay CA HAI locale, thay vi tu dung nut roi tu tim lai chuoi minh vua truyen vao.
impact: Doi lai: phai dung mot bo dich tay de lay ham t ngoai component be mat. Duoc: hai chieu do ma E11 khai (tro unavailable ve nhom storeUnreadable; ghi cung nhan) truoc do KHONG cai nao do, gio ca hai deu do.
